A presentation is a text file. A slide, and the clicks. A diagram, written as text. And this deck's own front matter, read from its file: it shows itself, turtles all the way down.

slides.md
diagram(dir="down")
  card#md.file(icon="file-text") slides.md
    | markdowndiagram(dir="down")
  card#md.file(icon="file-text") slides.md
    | markdown
    to(cli)  @1
  card#cli.tool(icon="terminal") glitu  @1:zoom @3-4:halo
    | one commanddiagram(dir="down")
  card#md.file(icon="file-text") slides.md
    | markdown
    to(cli)  @1
  card#cli.tool(icon="terminal") glitu  @1:zoom @3-4:halo
    | one command
    to(web)  @2
    to(pdf)  @2
    to(pptx)  @2
  zone#out.output What you get  @2:up
    card#web.output(icon="globe") A web page
    card#pdf.output(icon="file-down") A PDF
    card#pptx.output(icon="presentation") A PowerPoint
      | for your boss

The window slides aside: on the left the diagram's text, on the right the diagram. glitu, and its arrow. What comes out, the PowerPoint included. And the light on what matters.
